referencePrompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE transparent-background full-body animation reference for a cute 2D anime OBS mascot, square composition.
Input image 1 = approved exact classic alchemist witch costume and character identity. Input image 2 = her original mascot appearance and compact chibi proportions. Keep warm blonde hair, amber eyes, lemon-wedge hair clip on the same side, clean anime linework and cel shading.
She wears the approved charcoal bent pointed witch hat with burgundy band and brass buckle; short burgundy capelet with gold edge and lemon brooch; ivory blouse with rolled cuffs; charcoal modest knee-length skirt; burgundy sash; brown hip pouch plus exactly TWO yellow and purple potion vials; burgundy socks and brown boots. All fully clothed and wholesome. Do not change the costume design.
Scene: She is brewing a potion. One small rounded charcoal cast-iron cauldron with two handles, three short feet and a simple brass lemon emblem sits on the ground in front of her, slightly to the VIEWER'S RIGHT. It is filled with luminous mint-green liquid, opaque colored liquid not a hole. She holds ONE wooden stirring spoon in her hand on the VIEWER'S RIGHT, the other hand near the rim, looking at the potion with a focused small smile.
Pose = neutral stirring-ready pose; full hat, hair, skirt, hands, boots, cauldron and spoon visible with clean distinct silhouettes. Character centered at x=45% of the square, boot soles at y=90%; hat tip at y=10%. Cauldron centered x=64%, rim y=68%, feet y=90%, width roughly 30% of square. Both boots remain visible to the left/behind cauldron. Hands are anatomical and grip props naturally.
Keep the whole figure and prop assembly comfortably inside the square with at least 7% transparent padding on every edge. No floor, no ground shadow, no backdrop, no text, no border, no extra panels, no duplicate characters, no large glow haze. Genuine transparent alpha outside character and props. High quality crisp 2D illustration, not 3D.

sheets.name: alchemy1_start
sheets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent animation sprite sheet for the Sheddy Pet OBS mascot. Create a SQUARE sprite sheet with EXACTLY 4 columns × 4 rows = 16 separate frames, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Each of the 16 equal square cells has ONE full-body character and required props, completely inside its cell, with 10% clear transparent padding on all four sides. Exact evenly spaced invisible grid. No borders, labels, frame numbers or text. Do NOT merge cells or let hats/feet/effects cross into neighbors. Entire background genuinely transparent, no checkerboard, no floor or shadows.
Reference images define exact character identity, clean 2D anime linework/cel shading and approved costume. Preserve blonde hair, amber eyes, lemon hair clip. Witch costume must stay constant: charcoal pointed hat with burgundy band and brass buckle, burgundy short capelet and lemon brooch, ivory blouse, charcoal knee-length skirt, burgundy sash, brown pouch and yellow/purple potion vials, burgundy socks and brown boots. Use the provided brewing reference as the precise witch silhouette and cauldron design. Cauldron remains stationary on the VIEWER'S RIGHT in every frame where present. Its brass lemon emblem and mint-green potion remain consistent.
Camera fixed, full body, similar figure scale/boot baseline in every cell. No zoom/camera rotation. Keep human anatomy with TWO arms and TWO hands; no extra limbs. Character occupies around 70% of cell height including hat; all props/effects kept within padded cell. Animate with visibly distinct, natural progressive poses, expressions, body lean, arm arcs and hair secondary motion, not sixteen copies. Opaque character and opaque cauldron; background alpha only. Visual result needs to read clearly at 512px and as a small streaming overlay.
Clip: TRANSFORMATION AND PREPARATION. Reference 1 = original white laboratory coat mascot. Reference 2 = required final brewing pose. Reference 3 = approved witch costume. Frames 0–4 start in the original white coat, then she transforms into this exact witch outfit. Do not start already dressed as a witch.
16 frames:
0 original lab-coat idle, empty hands and no props.
1 lifts one hand, noticing a small lemon-colored magic spark.
2 brings hands to chest, knees bend, preparing a twirl.
3 half-turn in her original white coat, coat hem and blonde hair swing outward; a tight golden ribbon of magic wraps her torso.
4 brief pale-gold swirling silhouette hides the clothing change; face and boots still identifiable; no large opaque rectangle.
5 emerges three-quarter turned in the full burgundy/charcoal witch costume; pointed hat settles onto her head.
6 completes turn to front, cape and hair still swinging.
7 both hands steady the oversized hat brim with a pleased surprised face.
8 lowers hands, proudly displays the witch outfit.
9 points down to viewer-right, little green summoning curl at ground level.
10 small charcoal cauldron materializes on viewer-right at the position/size in reference 2.
11 leans over the cauldron and peers at the green liquid.
12 lifts the yellow potion vial from her belt with one hand, other hand rests on cauldron rim.
13 tips yellow vial into the cauldron, a short yellow stream; no spoon held yet, other hand remains on rim.
14 returns yellow vial to belt and reaches for the wooden spoon, potion gives small green bubbles.
15 exact brewing-ready pose from reference 2, holding spoon with viewer-right hand and other hand near rim; both belt vials present.
Keep the last four frames' cauldron anchored at the exact same place. All frames remain full-body with complete boots and hat.
